'''Dannik Malaan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was an employee for the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]] and lived in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Dannik Malaan appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
